boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Juniata destinations for studying, meeting, making, performing, and attending campus events.

cards.title: Statton Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons and library hub
cards.notes: Set up a study session, use a study area, or connect with Academic Resources here; the college identifies the building as a collaborative learning space.
cards.short_summary: A campus academic hub with study space and student-support connections.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata describes Statton Learning Commons as a space for collaborative learning and lists Academic Resources there.
cards.access_notes: College building hours list Statton Learning Commons separately; confirm access needs with the college.

cards.title: Ellis Hall
cards.subtitle: Baker Refectory, student offices, and campus services
cards.notes: Use Ellis Hall as a practical meet-up point before errands: the campus map places dining, student offices, the post office, and safety services in one building.
cards.short_summary: A service-and-dining building with several student-facing destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map lists Baker Refectory, Eagles Landing, the post office, student offices, and Public Safety in Ellis Hall.
cards.access_notes: The college’s building-hours page lists Ellis Hall as open 24/7; individual offices and dining services have separate operations.

cards.title: Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: In front of Halbritter Center for the Performing Arts
cards.notes: Use the open quad as an easy outdoor rendezvous before a scheduled campus event; Juniata designates it for major commencement-week gatherings.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor setting for major college ceremonies.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata’s 2026 commencement schedule places awards, baccalaureate, rehearsal, and commencement activities on the Campus Quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access and event setups can vary; follow posted event guidance.

cards.entity_name: Halbritter Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Halbritter Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: Rosenberger Auditorium and Suzanne von Liebig Theatre
cards.notes: Check the music calendar and meet in the lobby before a concert or student production; the center contains both major performance venues.
cards.short_summary: A named performing-arts center with two campus venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata identifies Rosenberger Auditorium and Suzanne von Liebig Theatre as spaces within Halbritter Center and schedules concerts there.
cards.access_notes: Building access is separate from event admission; consult the specific event listing.

cards.title: Juniata College Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Hall galleries
cards.notes: Plan a short gallery visit between classes and use the named Shoemaker or Malloy gallery as your destination; both are identified on the campus map.
cards.short_summary: The college art museum and its two named galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map places the Juniata College Museum of Art, Shoemaker Gallery, and Malloy Gallery in Carnegie Hall.
cards.access_notes: Check museum programming or building access before visiting.

cards.title: Kennedy Sports and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics offices and Memorial Gymnasium
cards.notes: Coordinate a recreation stop or attend a scheduled campus gathering here; the center includes Memorial Gymnasium and is a designated event fallback location.
cards.short_summary: A named sports-and-recreation center used for athletics and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Juniata’s commencement schedule names Memorial Gymnasium in the Kennedy Sports and Recreation Center as a rain location for several events.
cards.access_notes: College building hours list KSRC hours; facility areas and event access may differ.

cards.title: Swigart Music Hall
cards.subtitle: Campus music building
cards.notes: Use the named music building as a clear meeting point before rehearsals or performances, then confirm the relevant ensemble or department schedule.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus destination for music activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map identifies Swigart Music Hall as a campus building.
cards.access_notes: The college’s building-hours page lists Swigart Hall hours; access to rooms may be limited.

cards.entity_name: William J. von Liebig Center for Science
cards.title: William J. von Liebig Center for Science
cards.subtitle: Science departments, Jitters, and Eagle Access
cards.notes: Choose the main lobby as a straightforward meet-up before science classes or services; the campus map identifies academic departments plus Jitters and Eagle Access here.
cards.short_summary: A central science building with academic and student-service destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map lists biology, biochemistry, chemistry, health professions, Jitters, and Eagle Access in the von Liebig Center.
cards.access_notes: College building hours list VLB hours; access to instructional rooms may vary.

cards.title: World Languages Center
cards.subtitle: Named campus academic destination
cards.notes: Meet at this map-listed academic destination before language-related coursework or campus activities, and check with the department for room-level access.
cards.short_summary: A clearly named center for language-related academic activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map identifies the World Languages Center as a distinct campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building and room access with the college.

cards.title: Paul E. Hickes Observatory
cards.subtitle: Named campus observatory
cards.notes: Add the observatory to a science-oriented walk or a scheduled observing activity, and confirm whether a program is open before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A named on-campus observatory for astronomy-related activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Juniata campus map identifies Paul E. Hickes Observatory as a distinct campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Observatory access may be program-dependent; verify availability before visiting.
